All your people and AI agents working together

Slack connects your team. Slackbot multiplies what they can do.

GET STARTEDFIND YOUR PLAN

Trusted by top teams

Pause animation

Close deals
Plan launches
Chat with clients

Reimagine what’s possible with AI and agents
AI in Slack delivers action, not just answers. It’s tapped into the full context of your business, making every connected app and agent smarter in the process.
Turn data into action with Slackforce Surfaces
New
Automate tasks using Slackbot Skills
New
Build together in channels with Slack Code
New
Track and update sales pipelines with Slack CRM
Get fast answers with Claude
Play animation
What’s new in Slack
See all updates
Link may open in new tab
New Feature
To-Dos & Saved pages

To-dos just got a lot less cluttered, and now there's a home for everything you've saved.

Link may open in new tab
New Feature
Slack Code API

Any custom agent can now tap into and create a code channel experience.

Link may open in new tab
New
Event-Triggered Tasks

Slackbot now acts the moment something happens, no prompt needed.

Link may open in new tab
New Feature
Channel Insights

See how your channel is really doing, right inside the channel.

Link may open in new tab
New Feature
Start conversation with Slackbot or Agent in Workflow Builder

Workflows can now kick off a conversation with Slackbot or an agent.

Link may open in new tab
New Feature
Slackbot Mini

Full Slackbot now lives in a floating window on your menu bar.

Link may open in new tab
Feature Enhancement
Agents in the DM sidebar

Your agents now sit right next to your teammates in the sidebar.

Link may open in new tab
Feature Enhancement
Reorder navigation bar items

Arrange your left sidebar navigation tabs in the order you use them.

Knowledge
People
Process
Platform
Give everyone instant context
Get access to every file, decision, and conversation, so you can build on past work instead of recreating it.
Meet Slackbot: AI for the whole team
Slackbot knows your whole business and coordinates work across every connected app and agent. Now it works in channels too, so one person’s answer becomes the whole team’s.
Learn more about Slackbot
One search to rule them all.
AI-powered search puts your company’s entire memory at your fingertips.
Slack CRM: the new conversational CRM
Introducing Slack CRM, powered by Slackbot, your AI teammate. Capture contacts and move deals forward, right from your conversations.
5 hours
average time saved weekly with Slackbot1
Let your people connect like people
Slack’s conversational UI makes collaborating more approachable, whether you're working with a colleague or an agent.
It all starts with a channel.
Channels are flexible, transparent spaces for working with your team, AI assistants, and agents.
Learn about channels
When talking is easier than typing…
…hop on a huddle, our built-in video tool. With AI in Slack, your meeting notes write themselves.
Bring conversations out of the inbox.
Slack Connect lets you chat with clients and vendors in real-time, right from Slack. Email could never.
“Slack has been essential to our growth, our speed, and our ability to stay aligned as we scale”
Kate Jenson, Head of Americas, Anthropic
Manage all your work from one place
Automate daily stand-ups, project updates, and approvals so your team can focus on growth instead of guesswork.
Anyone can automate in Slack.
By click or by code, Slack makes it easy for anyone to build time-saving automations of their own.
Learn about workflows
Manage projects and tasks.
Track. Approve. Mark as complete. All without leaving the conversation.
A simpler way to get started.
Project manager's block? Beginning a brief? There’s a template for that.
35%
increase in time saved due to automations for Slack users2
Secure. Scaleable. Silo-free.
Our flexible, open platform is purpose-built for bringing the best agents and AI to every business, and can be tailored to fit however your teams work best.
From Atlassian to Zoom.
Google Drive. ChatGPT. Vercel. Box. Asana. Workday. You name it, it works in Slack.
See all integrations
Customize Slack to fit your needs.
Slack is flexible so you can build solutions specific to your business.
Work without worry.
If it’s shared in Slack, it’s safe. Our security program protects your data at every layer.
“Work starts in conversation. That’s why we see Slack as the natural place to build our agents.”
Guillermo Rauch, CEO, Vercel
The most innovative companies run their business in Slack
See all customer stories
Slack reimagines work for Anthropic at the speed of AI
GET STARTEDFIND YOUR PLAN
We’re in the business of growing businesses
94
%
of users seeing positive ROI1

Don’t just take our word for it.
Slack is a leader in over 290 G2 market reports.6
